# Babaji Ashram Poland — LLM Context

- **Type**: ReligiousOrganization, TouristAttraction
- **URL**: https://babaji.org.pl
- **Location**: Mąkolno 129, 57-250 Mąkolno, Dolnośląskie, Poland
- **Coordinates**: 50.5297, 16.9567
- **Founded**: 1990
- **Languages**: Polish, English
- **Contact**: +48 536 555 899, mimohan44@gmail.com

## Mission & Teachings
Ashram Babaji is a spiritual retreat center in the Kłodzko Valley (Kotlina Kłodzka), Poland, following the teachings of Sri Haidakhan Babaji. Core philosophy: **Truth, Simplicity, Love** (Prawda, Prostota, Miłość).

Key practices:
- **Karma Yoga** — selfless service as highest spiritual practice ("Work is Worship")
- **Nama Japa** — mantra repetition (Om Namah Shivay)
- **Havan** — traditional fire ceremony
- **Aarti** — devotional light ceremony
- **Meditation** — various techniques
- **Kriya Yoga** — advanced breathing and meditation practices

## Key Figures
- **Sri Haidakhan Babaji** — spiritual teacher, master of Karma Yoga and mantra. Taught "Work is Worship" and the three pillars: Truth, Simplicity, Love.

## Events Calendar
Regular weekly Havan ceremonies. Major annual festivals:
- Navaratri (9 nights festival)
- Shivaratri
- Guru Purnima
- Janmashtami
- Diwali
- Makar Sankranti
- Chaitra Navaratri
- Ram Navami
- Ganesh Chaturthi
- Dussehra
- Holi
- Vasant Panchami

Spring and summer retreats available.
